title: GHome Fingerprint Smart Door Knob with Keypad and App Control
description: Choose a GHome smart door knob with fingerprint access, a keypad and app control for a keyless entry upgrade. This listing brings three access methods into one door knob design. Check the exact model, door preparation, app requirements and any gateway requirements before ordering; Wi-Fi connectivity is not specified for this listing.

title: Homki Smart Deadbolt with Keypad and App Control
description: Shop the Homki smart deadbolt with a keypad and app control for your next keyless entry project. Compare this deadbolt with your current door layout, including the bore, backset and door thickness. Ask NLS to confirm the model and app requirements; this listing does not specify Wi-Fi support or remote access without additional equipment.

title: BEST 1CC7A2 Green 7-Pin SFIC Lock Core — Keys Not Included
description: BEST 1CC7A2 GREEN is a 7-pin small format interchangeable core (SFIC) in a green finish. This lock core is listed without keys. Match the core format and key system to your existing commercial hardware before ordering; SFIC and full size interchangeable cores (FSIC) are different formats. Operating and control keys must be selected separately for the appropriate system.

title: BEST A Keyway Control Key for Green Core — 1A2A2KS531KS681
description: This BEST A keyway control key is listed for a green core. A control key serves a different role from an operating key in an interchangeable core system. Verify that your core, keyway and keying requirements match part 1A2A2KS531KS681 before ordering. Choose this listing when your project calls for the specified control key rather than a standard door operating key.

title: BEST A Keyway Operating Key for Green Core — 1A3A2KS531KS681
description: This BEST operating key is listed for a green core with an A keyway. It is a separate item from the green core control key. Match the keyway and keying requirements of your interchangeable core system to part 1A3A2KS531KS681 before ordering. Contact NLS if you need help distinguishing the operating key from the control key for your project.

title: Schlage 23-030 C 626 FSIC Core — 6-Pin C Keyway, Satin Chrome
description: Schlage 23-030 C 626 is a full size interchangeable core (FSIC) with six pins, a C keyway and a satin chrome finish. The catalog lists this core as 1 bitted and non-handed. Check that your lock accepts this FSIC format and that the keyway and keying arrangement suit your project. This is a replacement core listing, not a complete door lockset.

title: Schlage 20-079 626 FSIC Rim Housing — Satin Chrome
description: Schlage 20-079 626 is an FSIC rim housing with a convertible tailpiece cam and a satin chrome finish. The listed housing is non-handed. Compare the core format, cam arrangement and mounting details with your existing rim lock hardware before ordering. This listing is for the rim housing; confirm the core and other components needed for your installation.

title: Falcon D271 626 Grade 2 Deadbolt with Occupancy Indicator — Satin Chrome
description: Falcon D271 626 is a Grade 2 deadbolt with thumbturn operation and an occupancy indicator in satin chrome. The catalog lists this deadbolt as non-handed. Review the indicator function and your existing door preparation when selecting commercial deadbolt hardware. Confirm the bore, backset, door thickness and included components with NLS before ordering.

title: Schlage 48-056 ICC Cut Control Key for Construction Core
description: Schlage 48-056 ICC is a cut control key for an ICC construction core, embossed on both sides. Match the ICC construction core system and required control-key function before ordering. This key listing is separate from an operating key and from a replacement construction core. Contact NLS to confirm the correct component for your existing hardware.

title: Schlage 48-101 ICC Cut Key for Construction Core
description: Schlage 48-101 ICC is a cut key for an ICC construction core, embossed on one side. Use the exact part number and your core information when comparing replacement construction-core keys. Confirm the required keying before ordering; matching a general brand name alone does not establish compatibility. A core is not part of this key listing.

title: BEST 12E72-S2RP626 1-1/8 Inch Rim Cylinder — 7-Pin SFIC Prep, Less Core
description: BEST 12E72-S2RP626 is a standard 1-1/8 inch rim cylinder with 7-pin SFIC preparation, a standard spindle and a satin chrome finish. The listing is less core. Check the rim cylinder dimensions, spindle and interchangeable core preparation against the lock being serviced. Select a compatible core separately and confirm the required mounting hardware before ordering.

title: Schlage 23-030 ICC ORG FSIC Construction Core — 6-Pin ICC Keyway
description: Schlage 23-030 ICC ORG is a six-pin full size interchangeable construction core with an ICC keyway. The catalog lists an applied finish and non-handed configuration. Match the core format and construction key system to your commercial lock before ordering. This listing is for the specified construction core rather than a complete lever lock or rim housing.

title: Schlage ND10S RHO 626 Grade 1 Rhodes Passage Lever — Satin Chrome
description: Schlage ND10S RHO 626 is a Grade 1 passage latch with a Rhodes lever in satin chrome. This is a non-keyed passage function, listed as non-handed. Choose passage hardware where a keyed locking function is not required, and verify the door preparation and application before ordering. Compare the exact ND10S model with any existing hardware you are replacing.

title: Kaba Ilco 7180DC-26D 1-1/8 Inch Dummy Mortise Cylinder — Satin Chrome
description: Kaba Ilco 7180DC-26D is a 1-1/8 inch dummy mortise cylinder in satin chrome. A dummy cylinder is different from a working keyed cylinder, so check the function your mortise lock installation requires. Compare the cylinder length and mounting requirements with the existing door hardware before ordering this replacement component.

title: Schlage ALX80P SAT 626 Grade 2 Saturn Storeroom Lever Lock — Satin Chrome
description: Schlage ALX80P SAT 626 is a Grade 2 storeroom cylindrical lock with a Saturn lever, conventional cylinder and field selectable Vandlgard. It has a satin chrome finish and is listed as non-handed. Match the storeroom function, cylinder requirements and door preparation when choosing this commercial lever lock. Confirm compatibility with any existing key system before ordering.

title: Adams Rite 4510-35-101-628 Deadlatch — 1-1/8 Inch Backset, Satin Aluminum
description: Adams Rite 4510-35-101-628 is a standard duty deadlatch with a flat faceplate, guarded latch, 1-1/8 inch backset and 4-5/8 inch mortise strike. The finish is satin aluminum clear anodized. The listed handing is left-handed or right hand reverse. Check the backset, door handing, strike and faceplate against your existing commercial door hardware before ordering.

title: Schlage ND80PD RHO 626 Grade 1 Rhodes Storeroom Lock — Satin Chrome
description: Schlage ND80PD RHO 626 is a Grade 1 storeroom lock with a Rhodes lever and a standard cylinder in satin chrome. The catalog lists it as non-handed. Compare the storeroom function, cylinder and door preparation when selecting replacement commercial lever hardware. Use the full model number to distinguish this lock from passage, privacy and other ND-series functions.

title: Adams Rite 4591-02-00-628 Curved Deadlatch Paddle — Satin Aluminum
description: Adams Rite 4591-02-00-628 is a curved deadlatch paddle for 1-3/4 inch thick doors in satin aluminum clear anodized finish. It is listed as push to left, for interior right-hand reverse or exterior left-handed applications. Confirm the push direction, door thickness, handing and deadlatch compatibility before choosing this commercial door paddle. This listing is for the paddle component.

title: Schlage F40 ELA 626 Grade 2 Elan Privacy Lever Lock — Satin Chrome
description: Schlage Residential F40 ELA 626 is a Grade 2 privacy lock with an Elan lever in satin chrome. Compare this privacy-function lever with your room and door requirements when selecting replacement interior hardware. Privacy and keyed entry are different lock functions; confirm that the F40 function, door preparation and finish match your project before ordering.

title: Adams Rite 4591-02-00-313 Curved Deadlatch Paddle — Dark Bronze
description: Adams Rite 4591-02-00-313 is a curved deadlatch paddle for 1-3/4 inch thick doors in dark bronze anodized aluminum. It is listed as push to left, for interior right-hand reverse or exterior left-handed applications. Check the push direction, handing, door thickness and compatible deadlatch before ordering. Compare the 313 finish with the satin aluminum version when matching existing hardware.

title: Kaba Ilco 7185SC1-26D-KD 1-1/8 Inch Mortise Cylinder — Schlage C Keyway
description: Kaba Ilco 7185SC1-26D-KD is a 1-1/8 inch mortise cylinder with five pins, drilled for six, and a Schlage C keyway. It has a standard 863G cam, keyed different configuration and satin chrome finish. Match the cylinder length, cam and keyway to your mortise lock before ordering. This listing is for the cylinder component rather than a complete mortise lock body.

title: Kaba Ilco R28207-9-26D SFIC Rim Housing — 6/7-Pin, Satin Chrome
description: Kaba Ilco R28207-9-26D is an SFIC rim housing for 6/7-pin cores, with a 1-3/8 inch dimension and thin head design. The supplied finish is satin chrome. Check the housing size and core format against your existing rim lock hardware. The product photograph is representative; refer to the listed satin chrome finish when ordering. Representative housing photo. Supplied finish: satin chrome.
